integrity: The infinite-family proof is supplied in full, with a separate exact rational finite checker. No external independent scientific audit or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact formula applies to the discrete-time degree-normalized simple random walk on unweighted cycles with exactly one previously absent chord. title: A single antipodal shortcut optimally reduces Kemeny transport on cycles
